candidate_name: Potential offshore FLNG / gas export tied to Block 8-9 exploration (TotalEnergies/Eni/QatarEnergy consortium)
current_state: Consortium signed an offshore exploration and production agreement for Block 8 in Lebanon's EEZ in January 2026 (3-year exploration period, 1,200 km2 3D seismic commitment, drill-or-drop clause by early 2029). No gas discovery has been announced; no terminal, liquefaction concept, site, or capacity has been proposed. This is upstream E&P, not yet an LNG-terminal candidate -- flagged here per the Discovery SOP's instruction to sweep upstream oil/gas operators for future FLNG sponsors in coastal hydrocarbon producers.
missing_threshold_elements: No terminal/liquefaction concept identified at all yet (fails all three threshold elements as a TERMINAL candidate: no terminal sponsor, no terminal site, no terminal-level concrete step) -- contingent entirely on a future gas discovery
watch_for: Any gas discovery announcement from Block 8/9 drilling (earliest possible per drill-or-drop clause: by ~2029), followed by any FLNG or export-terminal feasibility study, MOU, or FEED award naming a specific site/sponsor
notes: Re-check at the next Lebanon discovery/update batch and whenever Block 8/9 drilling news breaks. This is a very early, low-probability watch item -- not a near-term terminal candidate.
